qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: High gross margins (~66%) and proprietary Leica calibration/metrology software workflows create substantial switching costs, enabling above-inflation pricing across cycles.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 6 (ROIC 8.2% & flat EPS compounding, REJECT). Strong Leica Geosystems and industrial metrology franchises, but decades of debt/equity-funded M&A rollups have bloated invested capital with >€12B of goodwill, driving sub-hurdle GAAP ROIC (8.2%) and sluggish peak-to-peak Owner EPS compounding (0.5% CAGR).
qualitative.evidence: Reported GAAP ROIC median of 8.21% (2022: 8.4%, 2023: 8.0%, 2024: 9.0%, 2025: 5.8%). Goodwill and intangibles of €12.1B exceed total equity of €10.2B, leaving negative tangible equity. Net income fell from €1,023M in 2024 to €617M in 2025. 4-year Owner EPS CAGR is only 0.53% (peak 0.378 in 2024 falling to 0.293 in 2025). High gross margins (66%) and healthy FCF conversion (95.6%) are insufficient to overcome structurally dilutive acquisition accounting and industrial cyclicality.

evaluation_metadata.verdict: Rejected – G6 Cash & Fortress Balance Sheet
